examples.label: Email verification step in a signup flow
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stepper" site="Global" id="stepper-email-verification" variant="default" color="primary">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="verify-step-account" step="completed" step_number={1} title="Account created" description="Welcome, Sara" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="verify-step-email" step="current" step_number={2} title="Verify your email" description="We sent a link to sara@northwind.co" />
</.component>

examples.label: Payout step still clearing with the bank
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stepper" site="Global" id="stepper-payout-status" variant="default" color="success">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="payout-step-requested" step="completed" icon="hero-check-circle" title="Payout requested" description="12 March, 09:41" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="payout-step-clearing" step="loading" icon="hero-clock" title="Processing with your bank" description="Usually takes two working days" />
</.component>
